note: Messages and descriptions of the layout variants (0.5.0). Nothing here is filled in by the code.

messages.variantUnknown: That layout variant is not published for this document type; use an id from its published list
messages.variantMsn: The Medicare Summary Notice has a single layout, so it does not take a layout variant
messages.variantSeededAll: The layout variants seeded and all cannot be used in a batch that includes the Medicare Summary Notice
messages.variantRepeated: The layout-variant option was given more than once; give it only once
messages.variantEmpty: The layout-variant option needs a value
messages.variantAllHere: The layout variant all writes several documents, so it works only with render and batch
messages.unknownArgument: The call includes an argument that this tool does not take

developer.cliUsage: Layout variant: a published id for the type, seeded (picked by seed) or all (one document per id)
developer.mcpLayoutVariant: Optional. A layout variant id from this document type's published list, or seeded to pick one from the seed. Applies only to itemized-bill, ppo-eob and hmo-eob. Leave it out for the standard layout, unchanged. The answer key records which variant was used.
